name: @hubs/skills
//: Declares the skills tree as ESM. These files were .mjs, which the runtime
resolved unambiguously; after the .ts conversion Node could no longer tell
that a .ts file is an ES module and emitted MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON on
every invocation, re-parsing the file as a module on the way in. Scoping
"type": "module" here fixes the warning for all skill scripts without
touching the root package.json, where tools/ and plugins/ are loaded by the
OpenCode runtime and are unaffected either way.
